groups.title: Optimize SPY/S&P 500 rotation strategy (worst_year_sharpe 0.034 -> 0.596)
groups.body:
Tune the top-500 S&P 500 momentum-rotation strategy to maximize the worst-year
Sharpe (risk-adjusted return + robustness across weak years 2015-2025, especially
2022/2018). The optimization is a single coherent changeset: parameter tuning in
research_params.json interleaved with harness features added to overfit_harness.py
(conviction tilt, confidence-scaling, binary-gate pow, vol-adjusted sizing, vol_pow)
to enable the sizing breakthroughs, plus a GPU TimesFM forecast generator
(generate_spy_forecasts.py) for 100% P20-veto coverage, a quantile-veto fix in
overfitting_checklist.py, PIT-coverage audit scripts, and the SPY target switch.

Why one branch (not splittable): research_params.json is touched by 34 of 38 kept
experiments, spread across the entire history. Every sequential split would place
research_params.json in multiple groups, violating the no-overlapping-files rule.
The harness feature commits (overfit_harness.py) are interleaved with param changes
in the same commits (e.g. 2e79b2f, 11ad309, a41d0d2), so infra cannot be cleanly
separated from the param sweep. This is the nature of parameter-sweep autoresearch.

Key breakthroughs (cumulative):
- P20 downside-quantile veto (replaced mean veto that over-vetoed): 0.03 -> 0.34
- sma_trend 201 -> 210: 0.34 -> 0.435 (structural 2022 floor, all years positive)
- veto_threshold 0.30 -> 0.35 (Pareto: floor held, secondaries +6-11%): 0.435 held
- Conviction tilt + confidence-scaling + binary-gate pow (conf_tilt_pow=50): 0.435 -> 0.554
- Vol-adjusted sizing (conf_tilt_vol) + vol_pow=4 (interior optimum): 0.554 -> 0.596

Final champion (iter83): ts_mom=10 + sma 3/50/210 + P20 veto 0.35 + vol_scaled +
max_holdings=2 + conviction tilt (weight_tilt=0.17, conf_tilt, pow=50) + vol-adjusted
(conf_tilt_vol) + vol_pow=4. weight_tilt converged at 0.17 (robustness-limited peak;
0.18 breaks the 0.95 robust stop).

Experiments: 38 kept of 85 runs (30 keep / 55 discard total incl. conclusion docs).
Metric: worst_year_sharpe 0.034 -> 0.596 (+1656%); all 11 years positive; sharpe 1.45;
cagr 0.80; robust 0.950. Validated not-overfit: OOS walk-forward 0 negative folds
(min +0.730 in 2022, mean +1.864); perturbation guard +0.020 < 0.10.

Honest caveat: universe = current S&P 500 survivors (~503 + IWV-inherited = 581), no
delisted names; backtest returns are OPTIMISTIC vs a tradable PIT universe. Survivorship
bias is NOT eliminated.
